description: PART A: Add a repeatable, idempotent knowledge-ingestion script that ingests the uploaded skills/knowledge/*.md docs into the RAG knowledge base (Neon pgvector) via the EXISTING ingestDocument() pipeline. Must degrade cleanly when DATABASE_URL and/or AI embeddings are unset, must never run during build, and must not create duplicate documents on re-run. This feature is independent of the Part B method work (FEAT-002/003).
steps: Create web/scripts/ingest-knowledge.ts mirroring the pattern of web/scripts/seed.ts (lazy DATABASE_URL check via reading process.env; Spanish messages; exit(1) with a clear Spanish message WITHOUT touching anything if DATABASE_URL is unset; catch/describeError wrapper).

Resolve the repo-root skills/knowledge/ folder relative to web/ using fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) + path.resolve(HERE, '..', '..', 'skills', 'knowledge') (it is ONE level up from web/). Read all .md files there.

Add a PURE helper module (e.g. web/lib/knowledge/sources.ts) exporting a pure function that maps a filename (and optionally the first markdown heading / first line) to a document descriptor: { slug, title (sensible Spanish title derived from the H1 heading or filename), sourceType, sourceReference }. sourceType RESEARCH for the study-based docs (cip-r, magdalena-contreras, tipov, chaside, kuder-strong, autoorientacion, bernstein) — use RESEARCH as the default for these study/method docs; sourceReference taken from the doc's 'Bibliografía de Referencia' section where obvious (e.g. Fogliatto et al. 2003 for CIP-R; Alcaldía La Magdalena Contreras 2021 / Lizarazo 2024 for Magdalena Contreras). Keep this mapping a pure, testable function driven by the filename so it can be unit-tested without a live DB or filesystem.

IDEMPOTENCY: add a minimal idempotent-safe dedupe mechanism. Add a nullable UNIQUE 'source_key' TEXT column to knowledge_documents in web/db/schema.sql using an idempotent 'ALTER TABLE knowledge_documents ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key TEXT;' plus 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_knowledge_documents_source_key ON knowledge_documents (source_key);' (partial-unique on NOT NULL, or a plain unique index — NULLs are allowed multiple times in Postgres so pre-existing rows with NULL source_key are unaffected). The ingestion script computes source_key = the derived slug for each doc. On re-run, delete any existing knowledge_documents row with that source_key (ON DELETE CASCADE removes its chunks) BEFORE inserting the fresh document+chunks, so re-running never duplicates. Do NOT change the ingestDocument() contract if avoidable; instead, in the script, run the delete-by-source-key via lib/db query() and then set source_key on the freshly inserted document (e.g. UPDATE knowledge_documents SET source_key=$1 WHERE id=$2 right after ingestDocument returns its documentId). Keep every schema change idempotent and preserve the no-env build (schema.sql is only applied at runtime by db:seed / the script, never at build).

The script should: for each mapped .md doc, read its content, call the existing ingestDocument({title, sourceType, sourceReference, content, createdBy:'ingest-script'}); if ingest returns a warning about embeddings (AI not configured), collect and print it. After all docs, print a Spanish summary (documents ingested, total chunks, how many embedded) and, if any doc was stored without embeddings, print a clear Spanish note that semantic retrieval requires AI configured (AI_API_KEY/AI_BASE_URL) + a reindex. Ensure the script applies the schema first (reuse the splitSqlStatements + applySchema approach from seed.ts, or call a shared helper) so source_key column exists before use.

PDF: the file skills/knowledge/'Diseño de un instrumento de orientación vocacional.pdf' — extracting PDF text is OPTIONAL. Prefer to SKIP the PDF (the .md docs already carry the substantive content) and document that only .md docs are ingested. Do NOT add a heavy PDF dependency and do NOT block on it. If skipping, print a Spanish note that the PDF is not ingested in this step.
Add an npm script alias in web/package.json: "knowledge:ingest": "tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/ingest-knowledge.ts" (mirror db:seed exactly).

Add Vitest tests (web/tests/knowledge-sources.test.ts) covering the PURE filename->document mapping / slug derivation: correct slug for each known filename, sensible Spanish title, correct sourceType (RESEARCH), sourceReference presence for cip-r and magdalena-contreras, and stable/unique slugs across all .md filenames. Do NOT require a live DB.

Update web/README.md (Spanish): add a subsection under the knowledge/RAG area documenting how to run `npm run knowledge:ingest`, that it requires DATABASE_URL (and AI embeddings for semantic retrieval), that it is idempotent (safe to re-run; dedupes by source_key), that only the .md docs are ingested (PDF skipped), and that without AI configured the chunks are stored with NULL embedding and need a reindex once AI is set.
acceptance_criteria: web/scripts/ingest-knowledge.ts exists and, when run with DATABASE_URL unset, prints a Spanish message and exits WITHOUT attempting any DB or network work.
Running `npm run knowledge:ingest` with DATABASE_URL unset does not throw and does not touch the DB (verified by the lazy guard, since no live DB exists in sandbox).
web/db/schema.sql adds source_key idempotently (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS) and remains fully idempotent when re-applied.
The pure filename->document mapping is covered by web/tests/knowledge-sources.test.ts and all assertions pass.
web/README.md documents the ingestion command, its DATABASE_URL/AI requirements, its idempotency, PDF handling, and the NULL-embedding degradation.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx vitest --run`, and `env -u DATABASE_URL -u AI_API_KEY npm run build` all pass from web/.
verification: From web/ (after sourcing nvm): npm run typecheck
npx vitest --run  (new knowledge-sources tests pass; prior 115 still pass)
env -u DATABASE_URL -u AI_API_KEY npm run build  (no-env build still succeeds)
env -u DATABASE_URL npx tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/ingest-knowledge.ts  (confirm it prints the Spanish DATABASE_URL-missing message and exits non-zero without touching anything)
findings: Implemented web/scripts/ingest-knowledge.ts (mirrors seed.ts: lazy DATABASE_URL guard, splitSqlStatements/applySchema, describeError/main().catch), npm alias knowledge:ingest, pure web/lib/knowledge/sources.ts (describeKnowledgeSource/slugFromFilename/titleFromHeading), web/tests/knowledge-sources.test.ts (13 tests), idempotent source_key column + unique index in web/db/schema.sql, and a Spanish README subsection. Idempotency: script DELETEs by source_key before ingestDocument() then UPDATEs source_key on the returned documentId (chunks cascade). PDF is skipped and reported. sourceType=RESEARCH for all 7 docs; sourceReference filled for cip-r (Fogliatto et al. 2003) and magdalena-contreras (Alcaldia 2021 / Lizarazo 2024). Verification: typecheck clean, lint clean (No ESLint warnings or errors), vitest 128 passed (115 baseline + 13 new), env -u DATABASE_URL -u AI_API_KEY npm run build succeeds, and env -u DATABASE_URL run of the script prints the Spanish DATABASE_URL-missing message and exits 1 without touching DB/network. Could NOT run a real end-to-end ingestion (no live Neon/AI in sandbox) as expected.
